item.title: Diary: April 2021
item.description: Introduction I’ve been keeping a diary throughout my adult life, which sadly is longer than I care to admit. Most of it is complaining. The rest may or may not find its way out of my pocket notebook and into this site. 11 April I had promised Sunshine an excursion to the mountains. Though a man of routine, our weekend activities surely need renewal. There’s so many coffees one can have in a day.
